evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-13". A todo created without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH /todos/1 with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, and a later GET /todos/1 confirmed it was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "14.10.2026" returned 400. POST with "2026-10-14T10:00:00" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30", "2026-1-5" and 123 each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14 (UTC). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the not-done todo with due date 2026-10-01. Before that, the due-today, future-dated and no-date todos all showed overdue=false. After PATCH done:true, the done todo with due date 2026-01-01 changed from overdue=true to overdue=false.
evidence.AC5: The page at / listed each todo's due date as a time element: 13.10.2026, 14.10.2026, 01.10.2026 and 01.01.2026. The todo without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot, a mark element with the text "überfällig" appeared only on the two overdue todos (13.10.2026 and 01.10.2026). It did not appear on the due-today todo, the no-date todo or the done todo.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the two overdue todos (past and future).
